text_en: Illegally copies, discloses, or distributes the content of a telephone call or text message or any of the telecommunications services – whether he was an employee of a licensee or affiliated with it in a manner that enables him to have exposure to the content of a telephone call or text message or any of the telecommunications services.

(1) Whoever violates any provision of this Law’s provisions or its implementing regulations, or any regulations, resolutions, instructions, or rules issued pursuant to it, shall be punished with a fine that is not less than AED (50,000) Fifty Thousand Dirhams and does not exceed AED (200,000) Two Hundred Thousand Dirhams. Article (79) BIS (2) The Board of Directors may impose administrative fines on licensees in the event of their violation of the provisions of the law, its implementing regulations, decisions, regulations, policies or instructions issued by the Board of Directors or the Authority. The Cabinet shall issue a resolution on the schedule of violations and fines imposed on licensees provided they do not exceed (10,000,000) ten million dirhams for each violation.
